title: Recording: Little Woman Love by Wings | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul McCartney worked on the future Wings track ‘Little Woman Love’ on 20 January 1971.

Although this was one of the Ram recording sessions, the song was released as the b-side of Wings’ second single ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’.

The backing track for ‘Little Woman Love’ had been recorded on 13 November 1970. On this day McCartney added acoustic and electric guitar parts. He continued working on the song the following day.
